summary: Los Angeles County lookout built on Blue Ridge in 1928; the tower moved to Bodle Peak in 1930 and later to Triunfo Peak, and a stone residence cabin remains on the site.

facts.design: 60-foot open X-brace steel tower with an 8x8 observation-only cabin; a stone residence cabin was also built on the site
facts.status_note: The tower moved to Bodle Peak in 1930. A stone residence cabin remains on the site, per the register entry (registered 2019).
facts.agency: Built by the Los Angeles County Forestry Department (1928); the register lists the Los Angeles County Fire Department as administrator

events.note: Constructed by the Los Angeles County Forestry Department; register gives completion in 1928 as a 60-foot steel tower with an 8x8 cabin
Tower dismantled on Blue Ridge and moved to Bodle Peak in the Malibu Hills
June 14, 1932 newspaper item quoted by the register: the Blue Ridge station spotted a fire in the Lake Arrowhead area
Tower re-assembled at Bodle Peak during 1932 (Bodle Peak register entry)
Forest radio system tested from Blue Ridge, per a 1933 item quoted by the register; the item says 'the tower or the stone cabin'
Tower dismantled again and re-assembled on Triunfo Peak sometime after 1934

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1928 build is credited to the Los Angeles County Forestry Department; the register lists the Los Angeles County Fire Department as administrator, and Angeles Adventures notes the Forestry Department is now the Fire Department.

The Bodle Peak entry dates the dismantling at Blue Ridge to 1930. The Blue Ridge entry places the rebuild on Bodle Peak 'in 1930 or later', which is consistent with that move; the Bodle Peak entry's 1932 date is when it was re-assembled there.

notes_for_editor: Unresolved: (1) the 1933 radio item says 'the tower or the stone cabin' at Blue Ridge, which sits badly with the 1930 move; (2) the register gives 60 feet for the original tower, Angeles Adventures gives 50 feet for the moved tower; (3) Forest Lookouts spells it Bodel Peak, the register and Angeles Adventures Bodle Peak. No source read describes public access to the site today. The firelookout.org index also lists a different Blue Ridge (Tulare County, relocated to the Tulare County Fairgrounds); it is not this lookout. Record status 'gone' is consistent with the sources if read as tower only; the stone cabin is the surviving structure.
